settings.text: For protection and safety purposes, these products help prevent the spread of viruses and keep both your customers and employees safe.

settings.title: DISPOSABLE PROTECTIVE FACE MASKS
settings.text: Made to protect you against harmful airborne particles, these disposable face masks ensure normal breathing by allowing comfortable air circulation. FDA and CE compliant, these protective face masks are equipped with an elastic based fastening system that holds the mask in place perfectly over the wearers mouth and nose, while minimizing any open areas.

settings.title: GERM DEFENDER ACRYLIC SNEEZE GUARDS
settings.text: Made of top-quality acrylic, this Sneeze Guard features excellent durability and resiliency. Protect employees and customers against droplets from sneezing or coughing. Improve safety precautions in your workplace or establishment. It won’t break even if it hits the ground, making it perfect for retail stores, office desks, and restaurants.

settings.title: Extruded Acrylic Glass Sheets
settings.text: Extruded Acrylic Sheets have the clarity of glass and are highly durable with added impact resistance. This lightweight acrylic sheet is ideal for applications such as window replacement, shelf lining, desk top protection, and cabinet fronts. This impact-resistant sheet also features excellent weather ability and insulating properties.

settings.title: Sanitizing & Safety Message Mats
settings.text: These mats are perfect for keeping areas clean, sanitized, and safe. Direct customers and employees to sanitize their hands and practice social distancing. Disinfecting doormats help apply liquid disinfectant to the bottom of visitor’s shoes while also holding the liquid in place for long term use.
